overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no violation: the four-member gathering was below quorum so no meeting occurred, the June 5 notice revision was timely, and new allegations were declined.

allegations.summary: Four members allegedly met on June 1 in a closed meeting without notifying the full committee or posting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, because a quorum of the Committee was not present, it did not deliberate, thus there was no meeting requiring compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: After the June 1 gathering, the chair allegedly unlawfully revised the posted notice for the June 5 committee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The revision was made more than 48 hours prior to the June 5 meeting.

allegations.summary: Additional allegations raised only in the request for further review, not in the original complaint filed with the committee.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the additional allegations because they are beyond the scope of the original complaint filed with the public body.
